Hi — I'm Cameron Beeley. First-time mathlib contributor.

I've opened a small instance-transparency fix:

https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/42120
(perf(NumberTheory/NumberField): use show/from inferInstance for InfiniteAdeleRing instances, closes #42057)

Came out of work on Imperial's FLT formalization: deriving CommRing on InfiniteAdeleRing was emitting opaque _aux_* fields that fail isDefEq at instances transparency. Happy to answer questions on the PR.
